dedupe_keys.name: basel action network plastic waste trade data hub exports and imports of plastic waste hs 3915

description: This hub is the Basel Action Network's compilation of plastic waste trade statistics, produced by its Plastic Waste Transparency Project to hold exporters, importers, shipping lines and countries accountable for trade in plastic waste. It builds on official customs trade data for Harmonized System code 3915, plastic waste, parings and scrap, reported monthly by countries and compiled in the UN Comtrade database with a lag of one to two months, supplemented by national waste trade data that are published earlier or carry more detail, such as US exports by state. BAN presents key messages and metrics at global and country level, with charts and tables of the largest exporters and importers and trends, particularly after the Basel Convention plastic waste amendments took effect in 2021. Coverage is global, with a focus on exports from the United States, the European Union, Japan and other high income countries. The hub is free to view online. Caveats: it relies on declared customs codes, which miss mislabelled or mixed shipments, weights, not material quality are reported, and BAN is an advocacy organisation that selects what to highlight. Simulation uses: building plastic waste export flows for cross-border waste network models, and testing how import bans shift flows between countries. Related records: Basel Convention national reporting (data-basel-convention-national-reporting) records officially notified movements and Eurostat waste shipments (data-eurostat-env-wasship-transboundary-waste-shipments) cover European notified waste.
